findings.description: Fixed a bounded implementation gap where missing 30/50/100 resource preflight evidence caused the L09 audit to raise instead of producing a failed machine-readable rollup with a blocking finding.
evidence: scripts/audit_stability_soak_metrics.py: resource_profile now records resource_preflight_missing and returns a skipped profile with missing source hash.

proposed_harness.acceptance: Removing resource_preflight_100.json must make the L09 audit return status FAIL with category resource_preflight_missing while preserving real_valkey_coverage=false.

implementation_plan.step: Add regression coverage for missing resource preflight evidence.
implementation_plan.rationale: Prevents future crashes or fake pass behavior when a required resource preflight artifact is absent.

acceptance_criteria: L09 audit still passes against the current repository artifacts.
Missing required resource preflight evidence is reported as a blocking finding in the rollup instead of crashing.
Skipped 30/50/100 resource-aware profiles do not count as real Valkey stability coverage.
No P14 or 1000-node commands are run.
